d: When three restaurant workers are killed in a robbery/homicide in Las Vegas, the BAU looks at a cold case that happened in the town six years ago for leads.

When the BAU investigates incidents of bodies being incorporated into macabre graffiti art in Detroit, they suspect an elusive-yet-notorious street artist could be the UnSub. Dr. Lewis struggles to balance her relationship with her fiancé and her work.
When a woman is murdered in a small town in Florida, the BAU faces a community full of suspects. Also, Lewis receives a career opportunity that may take her away from the BAU.

The BAU helps Rossi's journalist daughter, Joy, investigate the disappearance of a college student. Also, the team is alarmed when Giuseppe Montolo dies in prison after he warns Morgan about the 'Dirty Dozen,' an underground group of hitmen.
The BAU hunts an UnSub in Phoenix who is kidnapping victims and depriving them of sleep. Also, Hotch and Garcia deal with the threat from the underground hitman group, the 'Dirty Dozen.'

After two undercover DEA agents are murdered, the BAU joins the NSA to investigate whether an underground Internet drug syndicate is involved. Hotch hopes the team's work with the NSA brings them closer to finding the 'Dirty Dozen.'
The BAU searches for an UnSub who may be fascinated with medical experimentation.
The BAU implements an elaborate strategy to try and take down the 'Dirty Dozen' hitmen ring, with Reid playing a central role. Aubrey Plaza guest stars.
When bodies are discovered in public places throughout Boston, the BAU investigates whether the victims used a taxi or ride-share service before their deaths.
The BAU searches for a motive and an UnSub when victims are found in truck stop restrooms along highways throughout the South.
When an 18-year-old girl escapes from a suburban home where she was held captive for years with two other women, the BAU searches for the Unsub who kidnapped them.
The BAU searches Los Angeles after the team discovers security footage that shows an UnSub being invited into victims' homes. Carmine Giovinazzo guest stars.
When Morgan is abducted, the BAU scrambles to find him and save his life. Danny Glover guest stars.
The BAU heads to Wichita in search of an UnSub abducting children while their parents sleep. Also, Morgan tries to find who was responsible for his attack.
When an UnSub targets the BAU, the team goes into action to find out who is responsible.

When former BAU team member and current Interpol Agent Emily Prentiss tracks an international serial killer, she enlists the help of her friends at the BAU after she is convinced the UnSub's next victim is on American soil.

The BAU searches for an UnSub who is purposely disfiguring victims. Also, Rossi has an awkward reunion with his ex-wife, Hayden Montgomery, who kept his daughter, Joy, a secret from him for nearly 30 years. Sheryl Lee Ralph guest stars.
